svg.title: Eppe vs Wegovy and Zepbound: weight loss beyond placebo
svg.desc: Eppe vs Wegovy and Zepbound: weight loss beyond placebo. Efpeglenatide (Eppe), Korea, 40 weeks: 8.13 percentage points more weight lost than placebo. Semaglutide (Wegovy), STEP 6, Japan and Korea, 68 weeks: 11.1 percentage points more weight lost than placebo. Semaglutide (Wegovy), US label Study 1, 68 weeks: 12.4 percentage points more weight lost than placebo. Tirzepatide (Zepbound), US label Study 1, highest dose, 72 weeks: 17.8 percentage points more weight lost than placebo. Tirzepatide, SURMOUNT-J, Japan, highest dose, 72 weeks: 21.1 percentage points more weight lost than placebo.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
